Messages.Author: Eric Jome
Messages.Body:
This is disappointing... I had really hoped to play in events at
Gencon this year. I guess I will reconsider my plans now - I would
run events myself, but I don't feel I have the proper experience with
the game to do this. And I don't know if an event could even be
registered at this point - the window is already closed.

Sad...

Messages.Author: Eric Jome
Messages.Body:
Well, I've had contact with the events organizers at Gencon and they
mentioned that they don't have events from White Wolf yet, but they
expect that WW will send them in eventually. That's good.

But it puts me in an awkward position. :/

I don't know whether to cancel my event or not. I asked for an event
for up to 64 players (hah!) on Saturday night beginning at 6pm... I
would expect to make it a standard format event. Is this likely to
conflict with events that White Wolf will run?

I'm not the best choice as event organizer - I can hardly be
considered a serious, tournament caliber player... but I am very good
at running events. After all, I've helped to run national sporting
championships ... so, I am sure I could try to pull this off.

What do people think... should I keep my event or try to delete it?
